metadata.subject: English
metadata.countingRule: Topics and skills are counted by grade placement. Repetition across different grades is preserved as curriculum progression.
integrityRules: Repeated topics and skills across different grades are preserved.
Only exact Grade + Main Topic + Subtopic duplicates are removed.
Clearly mismatched Main Topic labels are corrected only at the display layer and logged.
Age-only, adult, and grade-not-stated records remain outside Grade 1–12 pages.
Empty grade sections remain in the data source but are not rendered publicly.

description.en: Grammar, sentence structure, parts of speech, punctuation, capitalization, verb usage, phrases, clauses, and language mechanics.
description.ar: القواعد وبناء الجمل وأقسام الكلام وعلامات الترقيم والحروف الكبيرة واستخدام الأفعال والعبارات والجمل الفرعية والمهارات اللغوية.
